description: Notifies Bing, Yandex and the other IndexNow engines of up to 100 URLs of one site at once; it does not reach Google, and each engine decides when it crawls. It needs the site's IndexNow key file in place (indexnow_ready in list_sites) and takes 20 submissions per site a day. More than 10 URLs at once wait for the user's yes. Clients that can ask their user (MCP elicitation) get a question to confirm, and the answer does not pass through the model; with other clients the tool refuses first with a confirm token, and the call with that token stands for the user's yes.

confirm.description: The confirm token from this tool's refusal, once the user agreed

site.description: The site: its id (a UUID) or its domain, such as example.com

urls.description: URLs of this site, 100 at most

name: submit_indexnow
title: Submit URLs to IndexNow
